[EN] Mission Orders

Blood Legion troops in Thulsa's Ebon Tower depend on eternal hearts to resurrect.

Destroy Ksharan {@LinkCreature:473#2001#dreadreapers}, {@LinkCreature:473#3001#cleavers}, {@LinkCreature:473#3002#snipers}, and {@LinkCreature:473#4005#darkweavers}, as well as {@LinkCreature:473#5001#dark magisters} and {@LinkCreature:473#5002#eldritch priests}.

Bring their eternal beating hearts to Raneria in Habere when the mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Las tropas de la Blood Legion en la Ebon Tower de Thulsa dependen de corazones eternos para resucitar.

Destruye a los Ksharan {@LinkCreature:473#2001#dreadreapers}, {@LinkCreature:473#3001#cleavers}, {@LinkCreature:473#3002#snipers} y {@LinkCreature:473#4005#darkweavers}, así como a los {@LinkCreature:473#5001#dark magisters} y {@LinkCreature:473#5002#eldritch priests}.

Llévale sus corazones eternos latientes a Raneria en Habere cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
